expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: A circular loading spinner (white circle with a green arc) is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image. The image looks partially rendered, so it is either stuck loading or the spinner was not removed after loading. It covers the main subject of the image and makes the card look broken.

The time badges on the 'Fastest near you' cards ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') overlap the bottom edge of the food illustrations and sit close to the card edge. On the first card the badge partly covers the plate, which looks cramped.

The heart/favorite icons are white on semi-transparent dark circles over busy images. The pizza card's icon has weak separation from the background. The gray secondary text (delivery fees, 'Search', 'Orders', 'Profile' labels) also has fairly low contrast on white.
The promo banner has decorative translucent circles that are cut off awkwardly at the bottom-right corner, leaving a slightly odd edge artifact next to the rounded corner.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes a loading spinner remaining over already loaded or partially rendered card content.
